result.text: Both doses achieved statistical significance on both histopathology endpoints. NASH resolution (Pathologist A): 13% placebo, 27% (80 mg, difference 14 [95% CI 8, 20]), 36% (100 mg, difference 23 [95% CI 16, 30]). Fibrosis improvement (Pathologist A): 15% placebo, 23% (80 mg, difference 8 [95% CI 2, 14]), 28% (100 mg, difference 13 [95% CI 7, 20]).

citations.quote: In a statistical analysis incorporating both pathologists' independent readings, REZDIFFRA achieved statistical significance on both histopathology endpoints for both doses.
